window_automotive_rpm.name: Engine RPM (CAN)
window_automotive_rpm.description: Engine speed on CAN bus with mixed traffic. Message ID 0x0C0 contains RPM at bits 8-23.

window_automotive_coolant.name: Coolant Temperature (CAN)
window_automotive_coolant.description: Engine coolant temp on CAN bus. Message ID 0x105 with temp at bits 16-23, offset -40.

window_automotive_speed.name: Vehicle Speed (CAN)
window_automotive_speed.description: Vehicle speed on CAN bus. Message ID 0x1B0, little-endian 16-bit at bits 0-15.

window_industrial_pressure.name: Pressure Sensor (Modbus)
window_industrial_pressure.description: Industrial pressure transmitter on Modbus-like protocol. Slave address 0x10 with pressure at bits 0-11.

window_industrial_flow.name: Flow Rate (Industrial)
window_industrial_flow.description: Bidirectional flow meter. Device ID 0x25 with signed 16-bit flow at bits 8-23.

window_industrial_tank.name: Tank Level (Industrial)
window_industrial_tank.description: Ultrasonic tank level sensor. Device ID 0x30 with level percentage at bits 24-31.

window_iot_temperature.name: IoT Temperature Sensor
window_iot_temperature.description: Wireless temperature sensor network. Sensor ID 0xA1 with 12-bit signed temp at bits 4-15.

window_iot_humidity.name: IoT Humidity Sensor
window_iot_humidity.description: Wireless humidity sensor. Sensor ID 0xA2 with 8-bit humidity at bits 8-15.

window_iot_battery.name: IoT Battery Monitor
window_iot_battery.description: Battery voltage monitor for IoT devices. Sensor ID 0xB1 with 16-bit voltage at bits 0-15, little-endian.
